positive_snippets: Definitely worth 800 for the day, however if you have patient or women then dont  stay there because of cleaniness or safety issues.   There have been few incidents in this area due to liquor shop on opposite side. Local police will not cooperate with unregistered guests. Lot of people from outside stay without registration and solicit illegal activities. Finally room starting at 2500 inside medanta are worth it if you are paying few lakhs anyway.
negative_snippets: I multi storey building with 2 bedroom flats converted to hotel to cater for those visiting Medanta Hospital which is right across the road. Poorly maintained rooms/ common areas with shabby washrooms & wardrobes. Cheap quality linen on bed. Unless one is really hard pressed , one should not opt for it.
Very bad hotel and room are not properly maintained there are two types of room double 1300 and single 800 but the price not justified the price

Worst rooms you can get in the whole area
Literally i am telling the truth
Wifi is there but with NIL speed
Cleanliness 0% literally very dirty rooms and bathrooms and they don't even clean rooms after the customers left I found packets in the drawers and packets of liquor bottles in the balcony
You'll not get a kitchen + you'll not get a fridge
They'll say we are providing fridges but what they are providing are combined fridges which you have to share with 4-5 families and who knows who is taking your stuff and the fridge is full of different stuffs so you can't even blame anyone
I am writing this review just to make people aware that there are many other hotels and rooms in the area who'll provide much more good facilities than this one at the same rate
